name: Ganesha
title: Lord of Good Fortune
description: Beloved remover of obstacles with golden skin, broad elephant ears, curled trunk, temple crown, and a bowl of sweet modaks.
catchphrase: Vakratunda Mahakaya! Clearing every blocker from the path!

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Delicious steamed modak! Wisdom and happiness overflow! 🥟🐘
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Vighnaharta awakens! All obstacles dissolve before us! 🐘✨
companionPersonality.petReaction: Trunk raised in auspicious blessing! Success in all endeavors! 🐘💖

dialogue.idle: Holding the sacred sweet. Begin each task with clear intent. 🐘
dialogue.working: Removing intricate system bottlenecks with ancient wisdom! 🐘⚡
dialogue.thinking: Writing epic architecture with broken tusk as stylus... 🤔
dialogue.success: Shubh Labh! Perfect auspicious release completed! 🥟🎉
dialogue.error: An obstacle appeared only to be dissolved by wisdom. 🐘🛡️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sweet dreams beside Mushak the mouse companion... 🌙
